# Aura UI Direction

Aura is a cross-device smart-home and Sonos controller for NSPanel 120PW and NSPanel Pro Gen2 wall panels, iPhone, Fire HD, iPad Pro, and laptop browsers.

## Design Context

- Personality: intelligent, tactile, precise.
- Use one coherent information architecture across devices.
- Wall panels prioritize glanceable live state and large touch targets.
- Phones prioritize thumb-friendly controls and progressive disclosure.
- Tablets balance glanceable status with richer control surfaces.
- Laptops can reveal more music, home, and diagnostic detail without changing the mental model.
- Preserve the Aura observatory-inspired dark surface and amber/cyan state accents, refining them for legibility and calm.
- Never make hover the only way to discover or use an action.
- Keep live state obvious before secondary controls.
- Use stable dimensions, responsive constraints, and touch targets of at least 44px.
- Prefer precise status language and direct feedback over decorative UI.
